tier1.text: The femur, or thigh bone, helps form both the hip joint and the knee joint. It is the longest, heaviest and strongest bone in the body. Its rounded upper end, the head of the femur, meets the hip bone at the hip joint. Many hip and thigh muscles attach to the femur.
